anecdotes.title: JL healed her prolapsed pelvic floor on a carnivore diet
Melissa improved chronic fatigue, PCOS and endometriosis on carnivore diet

definition.text: Rectal prolapse happens when part of the large intestine's lowest section, the rectum, slips outside the muscular opening at the end of the digestive tract known as the anus. While rectal prolapse may cause pain, it's rarely a medical emergency.
